fields.description: Which Connector this event arrived through.
fields.label: Connector

fields.description: The source system's event UUID — the idempotency key. Unique: a duplicate delivery cannot create a second row.
fields.label: Event ID

fields.description: The source system's occurred_at timestamp (informational; signature freshness uses the per-attempt t).
fields.label: Occurred At

fields.description: Received = persisted + queued. Processed = handler succeeded. Failed = handler errored (failure_reason set); a source replay re-runs it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Reconciler-issued retries of process_event for events stuck Received or Failed. Capped at 3; beyond that the event stays Failed for a human (or a source replay with a fresh signature).
fields.label: Retry Count
